caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed object: a rusted metal lantern with a glass enclosure. The lantern features a broad, round metal top with visible corrosion and patches of green patina over a generally rusty brown surface. Two vertical metal rods descend from the rim of the top, running parallel on either side of the lantern, and connect to the lower base. The central section of the lantern contains a large, bulbous, translucent glass globe that curves outward in the middle and narrows at the bottom, designed to protect the flame or light source within. The base of the lantern is cylindrical with angular features and a small rectangular plate, and it is also covered in textured rust. There is a circular brass or copper turning knob on the front of the base. The overall color palette is dominated by shades of brown, red, and rust, with hints of green corrosion and metallic undertones. The lantern is centered on a beige background with no other objects present.
title: Street Post Lamp
